chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Oil smoothens the skin, increases in the brain, eases the flow of water (urine), removes scaling (dryness), and brightens the complexion.'

key_terms.الْقَشَفَ: Scaling or dryness of the skin
key_terms.مَجَارِيَ الْمَاءِ: The channels of water (referring to urine flow)

ai.seo_question: What are the physical health benefits of oiling the body according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi, attributes to Imam Ali (AS) a holistic view of oiling that bridges physical hygiene and internal vitality, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of emphasizing both bodily care and spiritual cleanliness. The mention of 'increasing brain matter' (idhhab al-qashaf) underscores the Shia scholarly appreciation for preventive medicine and the interconnectedness of physical well-being with mental clarity. It serves as a practical guideline for maintaining health (sihha) as a prerequisite for worship and daily duties.
